name: sharp
vision: Strong poses held still and changed quickly: reads at a distance and on a small low-polygon body.

idle: For a small or stylised body seen from far: the shift takes 26 frames and the head looks, holds and looks back.
Not tried: a shift under 20 frames. The held poses are still but for breath and fingers (3 degrees), which is the point of it.
walk: Sharp: a quiet trunk (the hips turn 6 degrees and tip 5, 32 mm of rise), a higher step, elbows bent 26 degrees, the two halves mirror images, parts trail under a frame.
Not tried: held keys with fewer in-betweens; every change is still eased, so it is quieter, not snappier, than the grounded one. Its keys are 19.8 KB a second in the file, the most of the three.
jog: Sharp: the knee lifts higher (the foot passes 13 cm over its straight path), the front hand comes higher than the back one goes, the hips turn 9 degrees and tip 5, the two halves mirror images.
Not tried: a shorter contact than the grounded one's six frames (five is 25 % of the cycle, under what people run with at this speed).
sprint: Sharp: more lean (the trunk 12 degrees forward), a higher knee, the elbows held at a right angle, the hips turn 14 degrees and tip 5, mirror images.
Not tried: 16 frames a cycle (225 steps a minute, over the range): a contact would be under four frames.
